recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The change is limited to the missing sentence from the published FHIR-34394 decision and is consistent with later Condition recorder decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-34394 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 Patient Care. It asked to clarify that Condition.recordedDate is the first recorded date while Condition.recorder is the most recent author, without renaming either element.
initial_application: Git commit 7fc5cd4fe9 initially applied FHIR-34394 by adding the requested recordedDate contrast sentence and the recorder comment. Commit 431d503d44 for FHIR-34395 later removed that recordedDate sentence when recorder/asserter were replaced by participant.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-39602 restored Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter, and FHIR-48804 refined the recorder definition while leaving the existing recorder comment that identifies recorder as the most recent author. Community searches found Patient Care minutes resolving FHIR-34394 and no conflicting Zulip discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml so Condition.recordedDate.comment again ends with: By contrast, the recorder is the most recent author.
source_changes: source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml: restored the final Condition.recordedDate.comment sentence contrasting recorder as the most recent author.
